name: Otoko no Ko☆Da!
source: The protagonist, Asuka, is currently job hunting and hoping to land an office position. However, he’s terrible at typing… but his next practical exam is at his dream company! Just as he was worrying about what to do, his childhood friend, Riku, suddenly showed up wearing a schoolgirl uniform! He even said he’d give Asuka a “reward” if he could type well…?
translation: 主角明日香目前正在找工作，希望能找到一份办公室职位。然而，他打字很糟糕……但他的下一次实践考试是在他梦想的公司！正当他发愁该怎么办时，青梅竹马的利库突然出现，穿着女学生服！他还说，如果明日香打字好的话，他会给他一个“奖励”……？
